host: Claude Code cloud container, Linux x86_64, 4 vCPU, 15 GiB RAM, Rust 1.99.0 pinned, warm Cargo registry
tool: cargo run -p xtask --bin local-channel -- deliver [--prove-rollback] -- <observation args>
method: Each row is a real commit delivered to a scratch dev channel (XDG_DATA_HOME in the session scratchpad), observed with `os capabilities --help` (root) or `--version` (core). Measurement commits lived on a local scratch branch and were never pushed. Idle host: no other build running at each start unless noted.

tests_overlap_build_same_target.note: test compile and dev build still serialize on one Cargo build lock

tests_in_own_target_concurrent.first_rep_note: each first rep's diff also carried the other package's revert commit, so both root and core tests compiled and ran (a two-package change)
tests_in_own_target_concurrent.warm_up_note: one-time: first delivery compiles every test dependency into <target>/deliver-tests (2.4 GB)

safety_checks: A commit with a stale root help snapshot: deliver exited 1, 'Unit tests `susi` of `susi` failed ... Nothing was promoted', channel.json sha256 and refs/susi/dev-live unchanged, while the dev build had run concurrently.

Known and unchanged: a change owned by susi-cli-defs that breaks only the dependent root package's snapshot test was promoted, because deliver runs the owning packages' unit tests only (docs/step1-acceptance.md).
contaminated_runs_discarded: Three pipelined root runs (8.2, 7.8, 7.7 s) overlapped a cargo-deny install compiling in the background and are not used.
